# MQL5

> MQL5 is the premier platform for algorithmic trading, expert advisors, and automated trading systems on MetaTrader 5.

MQL5 provides a comprehensive ecosystem for forex and financial market traders, combining the MQL5 programming language with MetaTrader 5 platform services including strategy testing, social trading signals, a marketplace for trading robots and indicators, and a freelance community of expert developers.

## Key Topics

- MQL5 Programming Language
- MetaTrader 5 Platform
- Expert Advisors (EA)
- Algorithmic Trading
- Automated Trading Systems
- Technical Indicators
- Strategy Tester
- Trading Signals
- Copy Trading
- Trading Robots
- Forex Trading
- Neural Networks & Machine Learning
- Trading Marketplace
- Freelance Development
- Economic Calendar
